objective: Find fresh unsolved Stable ACC rows that enter the already-qualified recursive free-face/fake-surface terminal basin after at most two rank-preserving official moves.

validation.note: The fresh authority run confirmed the unsolved count did not change between the full-row snapshot and the screen boundary.

conclusion: No currently unsolved Stable row lies within rank-preserving official-move distance <=2 of the qualified free-face basin.
